title: Wheat and Vine Leaf Risotto
subtitle: with tomato, pomegranate and yoghurt
description: Whole wheat simmered until tender and finished with butter and parmesan, then stirred through a savoury stew of vine leaves, tomato, white wine. Creamy like a risotto without the constant stirring.

steps.text: Soak the wheat in cold water for about half an hour, then rinse and drain.
Transfer to a pot with plenty of water, bring to the boil and cook on low heat for 30-40 minutes until tender.

Heat the olive oil in a wide pot and cook the chopped onions over low heat for about 5 minutes until translucent. Add the washed, chopped vine leaves, stir, cover and steam over low heat for another 20 minutes.
Add the peeled, chopped tomatoes, wine, the chopped lemon (seeds removed), pomegranate molasses, salt and allspice, stir and cook covered over low heat for about half an hour.
Drain the wheat, reserving a little of the cooking water, and add it to the pot. Add the butter and parmesan and stir until melted.
Drizzle the "risotto" with a little olive oil and serve with yoghurt.
